The '''Security Services Shooting Range''' was a shooting range for the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] Security services on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] met with the [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]], at the Shooting Range.
